name: Hamhock
summary: In the Stormwind Stockade, Hamhock remains locked among the rioting prisoners. The massive two-headed ogre is one of the prison’s most brutal inmates.

sections.title: A Brute Behind Bars
sections.body: Hamhock is a towering two-headed ogre in the Stormwind Stockade. The prison was built for petty thieves, murderers, and political dissidents, so his size makes him an imposing presence among the cells. When the prisoners rose up and took control, Hamhock stayed amid the disorder, crushing anyone who entered his cellblock.

sections.title: Murky Origins
sections.body: No record tells how Hamhock was captured or why he was locked among Stormwind’s thieves and dissidents. Whatever brought him to the Stockade, he is now one of its most dangerous inmates.

aliases: who is the ogre in stockade
faq.answer: Hamhock is a massive two-headed ogre held in the Stormwind Stockade. During the uprising led by Defias convicts, he is a danger deep in the prison corridors.

faq.q: How did an ogre end up in the Stormwind Stockade?
aliases: why is there an ogre in stockades
faq.answer: No record tells how Hamhock was captured or brought to Stormwind.

faq.q: Is Hamhock allied with the Defias rioters?
faq.answer: The Defias ringleaders lead the prison rebellion, but no one knows whether Hamhock works with them or simply revels in the chaos among the broken cells.

faq.q: Is Hamhock related to the ogres in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Nothing ties Hamhock to the ogres in Duskwood. The Splinter Fist ogres at Duskwood’s Vul'Gol Ogre Mound are the nearest ogre clan to Stormwind, but no record tells where Hamhock came from.

faq.q: Is Hamhock tied to any specific bounty or quest?
aliases: is there a quest for hamhock
faq.answer: No bounty or city warrant names Hamhock. He is a danger encountered while adventurers clear the rioting stronghold.

Two-headed ogres have distinct personalities in each head and are often more cunning or magically adept than their single-headed kin. That makes Hamhock exceptionally dangerous to ordinary prison guards.

angles.text: An unrestrained two-headed ogre beneath the capital’s streets shows how completely the city guards have lost control of the Stockade.
To subdue Hamhock, a warrior must meet his hulking strength head-on in the prison’s narrow halls.
